GenStone Pillar Panels are designed to cover an 8 inch square post while the columns are 17 inches square. The pillars can be terminated into the ceiling or capped with a 13.50 inch square flat or peaked cap. The caps are also available for columns in both a flat and peaked option, the column caps are 23 inches square.

Use the filter below to sort our stone pillar and stone column products.

Pillar Panels 101

The each stone pillar panel is 48 inches tall can be either stacked vertically for taller posts or cut down for shorter posts. If your post is smaller than 8 inches square, you can simply fur your post out with one or two vertical furring strips on each side of the post. If your post is larger than 8 inches, we suggest our column kits for posts up to 17 inches square or our stacked stone panels for posts that are larger than 17 inches square.

Note: you will need 4 pillar panels to cover a 48 inch tall post as shown in the pictures.

Columns 101

GenStone column kits are are completed by attaching four GenStone 90º outside corner panels. The corner panels are 23.50 inches tall and can be stacked vertically to create any size stone column. The column examples below were created with eight outside corners and one flat column cap.

Connect with Our Team

Need Help? Tap Project SOS and we will assign your project to a Project Coordinator out of our office in Colorado . Your Project Coordinator will guide you through color selection, how much GenStone you need and be your single point of contact for any installation questions you may have along the way.
